Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, Lord of the Great Light
And Lord of the Exalted Throne
And Lord of the Swelling Sea
And the One who sent down the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms
And Lord of the Shade and the Heat
And the One who sent down the Great Quran
And Lord of the close angels
And the prophets and messengers
O Allah, I ask You by Your Noble Face
And by the Light of Your Radiant Face
And Your Eternal Kingdom
O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ أَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرَضُونَ
Translation: I ask You by Your Name through which the heavens and earths shine

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ يَصْلَحُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ
Translation: And by Your Name through which the first and the last are set right
O Living before every living thing
And O Living after every living thing
And O Living when there is no living
O Giver of life to the dead and Bringer of death to the living
O Ever-Living, there is no god but You

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلاَنَا الْإِمَامَ الْهَادِيَ الْمَهْدِيَّ الْقَائِمَ بِأَمْرِكَ
Translation: O Allah, convey to our Master, the Imam, the Guide, the Guided, the One Entrusted with Your Command

Arabic text: صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آبَائِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: May the blessings of Allah be upon him and upon his pure forefathers
From all believing men and believing women
In the east and west of the earth
Its plains and its mountains
Its lands and its seas
And from me and my parents
Of the prayers equal to the weight of Allah's Throne
And the ink of His words

Arabic text: وَمَا أَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُهُ وَأَحَاطَ بِهِ كِتَابُهُ
Translation: And what His knowledge has enumerated and His Book encompasses

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أُجَدِّدُ لَهُ فِيْ صَبِيحَةِ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا
Translation: O Allah, I renew for him on this morning of my day
And for as long as I live from my days

Arabic text: عَهْدًا وَعَقْدًا وَبَيْعَةً لَهُ فِيْ عُنُقِي
Translation: A pledge, a covenant, and an allegiance to him upon my neck

Arabic text: لَا أَحُولُ عَنْهَا وَلَا أَزُولُ أَبَدًا
Translation: From which I will never turn away nor deviate ever
O Allah, make me among his helpers
And his supporters and defenders
And those who hasten to fulfill his needs
And those who comply with his commands
And those who protect him
And those who hasten to his will
And those who attain martyrdom before him

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنْ حَالَ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُ الْمَوْتُ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهُ عَلٰى عِبَادِكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا
Translation: O Allah, if death, which You have decreed upon Your servants as inevitable, comes between me and him
Then bring me out from my grave, wrapped in my shroud
With my sword unsheathed
My spear drawn

Arabic text: مُلَبِّيًا دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِيْ فِيْ الْحَاضِرِ وَالْبَادِي
Translation: Answering the call of the caller in cities and deserts
O Allah, show me the rightly guided countenance
And the praiseworthy appearance
And delight my eyes with a glance from me to him
And hasten his relief
And ease his emergence
And make his path wide
And let me follow his way
And implement his command
And strengthen his back
And O Allah, through him, cultivate Your lands
And revive Your servants
For You have said, and Your word is the truth:

Arabic text: ظَهَرَ الْفَسٰادُ فِيْ الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ
Translation: "Corruption has appeared on land and sea
Because of what the hands of people have earned"
So O Allah, show us Your representative
The son of Your Prophet's daughter
Named after Your Messenger
May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family

Arabic text: حَتَّىٰ لَايَظْفَرَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْبَاطِلِ إِلَّا مَزَّقَهُ
Translation: So that he leaves no falsehood without tearing it apart
And establishes truth and confirms it
And O Allah, make him a refuge for Your oppressed servants

Arabic text: وَنَاصِرًا لِمَنْ لَايَجِدُ لَهُ نَاصِرًا غَيْرَكَ
Translation: And a helper for those who find no helper other than You

Arabic text: وَمُجَدِّدًا لِمَا عُطِّلَ مِنْ أَحْكَامِ كِتَابِكَ
Translation: And a reviver of what has been abandoned from the rulings of Your Book

Arabic text: وَمُشَيِّدًا لِمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ أَعْلاَمِ دِينِكَ وَسُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: And a reinforcer of what has come of the signs of Your religion and the traditions of Your Prophet
May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْهُ اللَّهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِنْ بَأْسِ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ
Translation: And O Allah, make him among those whom You have protected from the might of the transgressors
O Allah, gladden Your Prophet Muhammad
May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family
By the sight of him and those who follow his call
And have mercy on our weakness after him

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْشِفْ هٰذِهِ الْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هٰذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ بِحُضُورِهِ
Translation: O Allah, remove this distress from this nation by his presence
And hasten for us his appearance
They see it as distant, but we see it as near
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: اَلْعَجَلَ الْعَجَلَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
Translation: Hasten, hasten, O my Master, O Master of the Time
